about.description: Multipli offers a stablecoin backed by real-world assets and Treasury securities, combining yield generation with price stability. It enables institutional-grade stable settlement with underlying RWA collateral.
about.registryInfo: Reviewed public materials describe rwaUSDi as a Multipli-issued institutional, permissioned credit layer for tokenized private markets. Specific corporate registry details for the operating entity behind rwaUSDi were not clearly disclosed in the reviewed public materials.
